$comment: Ceilings on the STATIC IMPORT GRAPH, checked by scripts/perf/check-budget.mjs
(`npm run perf:budget`) and held on every push by the last two cases of
scripts/perf/__tests__/check-budget.test.mjs, which CI already runs as test:perf.
What it measures is cost per REQUEST rather than bundle size: Next compiles a
route s entire module graph on first hit with no tree-shaking, so the number of
first-party modules on a path tracks what an operator waits for almost linearly.
THESE NUMBERS WERE MEASURED, not chosen — `--record` walked this tree and wrote
each ceiling as the measurement plus slackPercent (15). Ordinary growth does not
trip them; a doubling does. `--tighten` lowers them to what the tree costs today
and can never raise one.
The group ceiling is the p95 route, not the worst: one fat route must not buy
headroom for all 200. A route above the p95 gets a named override with its own
measured ceiling, so it is visible in the diff instead of hidden under a
generous number. `overrides` being empty means no route was an outlier.
THE BARREL RULE HAS NO SLACK, on purpose. `maxValueImporters` is the exact count
at the time of recording: importing app/_lib/db.ts FOR VALUE drags all 17 store
modules into the importer and everything downstream of it, so the 28th importer
is meant to stop and import the slice instead (`import type` is erased before
bundling and is not counted). Raising this number is a decision, not a fix.
Raising any ceiling is an edit to this file with a why a reviewer can disagree
with. `npm run perf:budget -- --explain <path>` shows what is on a path.

app/page.tsx.why: the whole ?tab= workspace behind one URL — 983 first-party modules when app-structure.md measured it, and the single page every operator waits on

app/_lib/llm-config.ts.why: a hub module: its graph is multiplied across every importer, which is how a barrel import in ONE file inflated a hundred routes (57 modules -> 13 after the sweep). Raised 294 -> 297 KB on 2026-09-21: the module SET on this path is byte-for-byte the one that was recorded (16 modules against a ceiling of 19, no module added or removed since 51d1fc479) — the 10 KB is db/core.ts's DDL growing by six tables' worth of columns, db/llm.ts by two, tenancy.ts by one. There is no import to remove, and a ceiling that fires on a 3% text edit to a file already on the path is measuring the wrong thing. The module ceiling is what guards this hub and it is untouched

app/_lib/job-ingest.ts.why: the other hub the barrel sweep shrank (60 modules -> 20); it is on the path of most job routes. Raised 351 -> 375 KB on 2026-09-16: app/_lib/db/core.ts grew by the four job-seeker tables' DDL (+114 lines) and core.ts is on this path; no new module was added. Raised 375 -> 377 KB on 2026-09-21: one 6 KB store module joined the path (db/job-translations.ts, the per-locale job copy the ingest writes) and core.ts grew another 6 KB of DDL; 27 modules against a ceiling of 28, so the module ceiling still holds it

app/api/**/route.ts.why: cost per request: next compiles a route entire module graph on first hit with no tree-shaking, and the measured cost tracks graph size almost linearly. Raised 2663 -> 2700 on 2026-09-05 when two independently gated trees merged (the /tiger LLM use-case catalog + call provenance, and /perfect round 45 voice metering): 28 routes measured 2665-2690 KB, a 1% overshoot with no single new import to remove; the next --tighten should bring it back down. Raised 2700 -> 2850 on 2026-09-16 (candidate-jobseeker spark): the baseline commit 83f4979f was already at 2729 KB on the top route (a 1% overshoot nobody had answered), and the branch adds ~2% across every route on the task hub's path through core.ts DDL for four tables, fourteen error codes and the scheduler registry — no new module (the scan itself is late-bound, see task-external-runners.ts); modules stay at 222 against 225. The next --tighten should bring it back down

app/api/agents/hire-from-need/route.ts.why: the one route above the group's p95 after the stage-hook cut of 2026-09-21 (224 modules / 2873 KB against 225 / 2850, every other route 219 or below). Named here rather than bought with a group raise, which is what this file says an outlier gets: it reaches the task hub through repo-scan.ts, so it pays for the devcase, group-eval and companion runners on top of the hiring graph. THE REAL CUT is moving those runners behind app/_lib/task-external-runners.ts the way jobseeker_scan already is (~220 KB off EVERY route, not just this one); until somebody does that, this number says which route is waiting on it. The module ceiling is unchanged

app/_lib/db.ts.why: the export * barrel over 17 store modules. Importing it for value drags the whole data layer into the importer and everything downstream of it — import the slice instead
